captions.content: The Princess Frog lets out a final wail as it dissolves into purple sludge. The controlled scouts collapse, unconscious but still alive.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: In the center of the crater, the monstrous, purple form of Ives sways. The cold rushing back as the adrenaline fades.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: She crashes into the snow.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Ives!
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie presses her fingers to Ives neck, checking for a pulse.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...Jackie?
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I'm here! Just... hold on. We have to get you back to Kade.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: I can't move my legs, kid.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: The world is... spinning.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I got you. I can carry you back. Just please, please hang on!
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Hah...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: ...Sorry, kid.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I can't be making any more promises I can't keep.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie freezes. A familiar feeling rises up her throat, threatening to burst from her chest.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: It tells her in her own voice:
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: She's hurt and it's all your fault. You're killing her.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Ives, I'm so sor-
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: But then Jackie catches herself. She hears Cam's voice.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: The apology stops burning in her throat.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...But how...
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: The one thing I can promise you… is that I will always be so proud of you. Even if I'm not here.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Because I know you're constantly changing for the better.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: And because I'm so proud of you right now.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You found out what happened to your mother, and you defeated that Frog.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: But I never did that alone... Cam... You were with me. Without you... what am I going to...
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: There will always be more people like me. But you'll never find them, if you don't open your heart… and let them in.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I'll try… I… wish I saw it sooner. What you all were doing for me. So I could do the same for you.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: I get it... you feel like a fraud... Like you're never doing enough for the people around you.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You wonder why you get so much, when you can offer so little.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You may not feel like you've done a lot for me, but that's where you're wrong.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Raising you was the best thing that ever happened to me.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You could never be a burden, kid.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: When Ailin left me behind, I thought it was because I wasn't enough of a soldier.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: But I realized that... she didn't need a soldier. She needed... a friend, for me and for you to have a family.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You gave me purpose, kid. You made me realize... you don't have to save the world to be enough for someone. Sometimes you just have to be there.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: And you were always there for me.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: You can't ever know what being enough is for someone else. So all you can do is be there for them...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Can you promise me that?
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I... will... I will always be there for you.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Good...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: That's good...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Tell Cam that too...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Ives lets out a long, slow breath. Her eyes close and the movement of her chest slows.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Jackie sits in the snow.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: She wipes her eyes.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...I'm here.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: She stands up, taking Ives' arm, and puts it around her shoulder.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: And begins the long trek back towards the firelight.
captions.speaker: Narration
